papers.headline: Probing the Reionization History and Bubble Sizes with JWST Lyman-α Fraction Measurements
papers.summary: Recent James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) measurements quantify the fraction of ultraviolet-selected galaxies showing detectable Lyman-alpha (Ly-α) lines at z ∼ 6-14.
papers.title: Probing the Reionization History and Bubble Sizes with JWST Lyman-α Fraction Measurements
papers.authors: A. Kundu, A. Lidz, G. Sun

papers.headline: Two bits about lossy compression: On the limits of compression in cosmology
papers.summary: Astronomy is in an era of enormous sky surveys and of the large simulation suites needed to interpret them, both costly to store and slow to share.
papers.title: Two bits about lossy compression: On the limits of compression in cosmology

papers.headline: Is DESI Seeing Dynamical Dark Energy, or a Cosmic Glitch in Gravity?
papers.summary: Combined baryon acoustic oscillation and cosmic microwave background data have begun to mildly favor departures from ΛCDM. This is usually framed as 2-parameter dynamical dark energy.
papers.title: Is DESI Seeing Dynamical Dark Energy, or a Cosmic Glitch in Gravity?
